run.procedureSummary:
Script used: C:\Users\USER\AppData\Local\Temp\om\desk-250\sim.py (Python). Each cycle runs these steps in order:
1. Feed: add that cycle's feed vector to each chamber. Capacity is ignored and PUPAL chambers are fed too.
2. Overflow: go through chambers 1 to 6 in turn. If a chamber holds more than its capacity, set it to capacity and add the excess to the next chamber before that chamber is checked. Excess from chamber 6 goes to the tally. Overflow applies to chambers in either state.
3. Check: each chamber is judged once, against its state at the start of the step. A LARVAL chamber with quantity >= its upper mark becomes PUPAL. A PUPAL chamber with quantity <= its lower mark becomes LARVAL. Otherwise nothing changes.
4. Metabolism: all amounts come from the quantities after the check, then everything moves at once. A LARVAL chamber loses floor(q/4) to the tally. A PUPAL chamber loses floor(q/2), which goes to the previous chamber (chamber 1's goes to the tally). Capacity is not enforced here; any excess stays until the next cycle's overflow step.
5. Moult: if the line total after metabolism is strictly greater than 38, every chamber becomes floor(q/2) and the removed amount (q - floor(q/2)) goes to the tally.

openPoints.point: Halving rounding in the moult: does 'rounded down' apply to what stays or to what is removed?
openPoints.assumption: What stays is rounded down: new = floor(q/2), removed = q - floor(q/2), so an odd unit goes to the tally.
Strictly greater than 38. Cycle 5 ends at exactly 38, so no moult fires in cycle 5.

openPoints.point: When the line total for the moult is measured
openPoints.assumption: After metabolism in the same cycle, over all six chambers in both states.
Sequential. Excess passed on is counted in the receiving chamber before that chamber's own overflow test, so cascades run within one pass from chamber 1 to 6.

Each chamber transitions at most once per check, based on its state at the start of the step. A chamber that just became PUPAL is not re-tested against its lower mark in the same step. 'Routinely' is read as no extra condition.

openPoints.point: Which quantities metabolism uses, and states
openPoints.assumption: Quantities after the check, with states as updated by that check. Mass a PUPAL chamber receives from the next chamber does not change its own amount this step.

Left over capacity (for example chamber 2 at 10 against capacity 8 after cycle 1 metabolism). They are only corrected at the next overflow step. The final cycle-5 quantities therefore include chamber 2 at 10 against capacity 8, reported as it stands.

openPoints.point: Rounding of a quarter and a half in metabolism
openPoints.assumption: Floor per chamber: floor(q/4) and floor(q/2).

run.notes: I checked cycle 1 by hand against the script's output and it matches. The script is at C:\Users\USER\AppData\Local\Temp\om\desk-250\sim.py; I used only that folder and ran no git. Cycle 5 is a boundary case: the total after metabolism is exactly 38, so the moult does not fire. If 'over 38' meant 38 or more, the cycle 5 results would change.
